details: People have gathered in front of the Government building calling “Nikol, traitor!”. They called for the cancellation of November 9 document.
Russia has sent 1960 peacekeepers and 470 units of munitions.
The announcement about creating a trilateral Working Group for opening communications according to paragraph 9 of Nov 9 statement.
Armenian PM resigns in the face of political and military opposition to have snap elections.

event: Azeri forces advance inside Armenia proper
details: Azeris cross the border near the Black Lake and advance 3,5 km. Arm government dismissed Azerbaijan’s excuse based on some maps: “we have maps […] that clearly show how the border [goes].”
Secretary General Stanislav Zas: “What we’re dealing with here is, essentially, a border incident.”
Initiation of bilateral commission on delimitation and demarcation among other things
Aliyev insists here that Zangezur corridor be operating in the same way as Lachin corridor, while N. Pashinyan says that it drives the opening of communications to a dead-end.
Initiation of EU-France-Armenia-Azerbaijan format.

Deadline to set up the delimitation/demarcation committee by the end of the month. Foreign ministers to start preparations for peace talks. Meanwhile US and France refuse to work with Russia in OSCE framework.
Large offensive on the border of Armenia in Gegharkunik, Vayots Dzor, Syunik. AZ accused ARM of provocations in Dashkasan, Kalbajar, Lachin. ~300 killed. Over 7,600 displaced.

EU to send Civilian Mission to the Armenian border with Azerbaijan. Both countries reinstated their commitment to the 1991 Alma-Ata. 44 European countries present excluding Russia and Belarus. Pivot to the West.
“eco-activists” had again blocked the only road connecting NKR to Armenia, this time setting stone to the humanitarian crisis.
USA enters as a mediator
ICJ voted 13-2 in favor of the provision to Azerbaijan requesting to open Lachin corridor to unimpeded movement.

event: AZ to install checkpoint on Lachin corridor
details: Another breach of the Nov 9 agreement—setting a checkpoint on Lachin—stating that Armenia transports munitions to NKR and sets landmines.
One more trilateral with the EU with no significant outcomes.

The 24-hour “Anti-Terrorist Operation” added to more than 9 months of blockade resulted in the exodus of over 100,000 to Armenia. The next day protests began in Yerevan against the PM for failing to protect compatriots in NKR.
“It is obvious that Russia has betrayed the Armenian people. […] Azerbaijan conducted military action with no reaction from [Russian] peacekeepers”.
By October 4, most high-ranking government officials were captured and sent to Baku. Sham trials begin Jan 17, 2025.
N. Pashinyan mentions in France 24 interview that Armenia has essentially frozen its membership in CSTO because of failure to come to Armenia’s defence.

event: 8th meeting of the Commission on Delimitation
details: Azerbaijan gained back its full control over 4 border villages which used to be neutral zones. Agreed to deploy border services to those sections of the borderline.

People are against the delimitation protests claiming that Armenian roads are being handed over. Bagrat Srbazan’s reached the republic square on May 9 where ~20,000 people gathered demanding Pashinyan’s resignation.
Turkish Ambassador Serdar Kilic and Armenian parliament deputy speaker Ruben Rubinyan met to discuss normalization of relations. They first met in Jan 2022.
Meeting of Foreign Affairs ministers of both countries hosted by Secretary of State Blinken.
Armenia announced that starting Jan 1, 2025, Russian border guards will cease operation at the Armenian-Iranian border checkpoint.
Pashinyan and Aliyev met in Kazan, Russia, on the sidelines of BRICS summit.
According to a senior MP Sargis Khandanyan Armenian did not participate in COP29 due to Azerbaijan’s failure to release at least 23 Armenian prisoners.
At the initiative of Georgian foreign minister a trilateral meeting took place to advance cooperation and development across the countries of South Caucasus.
A joint declaration signed by Armenia and Azerbaijan and US as a witness. Trump Route for International Peace and Prosperity
OSCE Minsk Group serving to mediate in the Nagorno-Karabakh conflict will be dissolved by the end of 2025.
